responsibility: Generated URL-mapping companion for the generated NVPTX option fragment nvptx-gen.opt. In GCC’s option-documentation machinery, .opt.urls files attach manual URL suffix metadata to option records; this file is regenerated from the generated option definitions and the built HTML manuals so any documented generated -misa= architecture enum entries in nvptx-gen.opt can link back to the appropriate NVPTX options manual location without adding backend logic of its own.
